commands:
set -euo pipefail
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export PATH="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin:$PATH"
EXPECTED_MAIN=d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad
EXPECTED_BRANCH=0519f54afa4dba50b51409d14d375df2c4dbead8
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "$EXPECTED_BRANCH"
git checkout -B agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/src/test/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/developerrelay/ChatRelayTurnPacingTest.kt')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''    @Test
    fun `post tx hold covers full buffered speech plus guard`() {
        assertEquals(1_250L, ChatRelayTurnPacing.postTxHoldMs(32_000))
        assertEquals(1_656L, ChatRelayTurnPacing.postTxHoldMs(44_994))
    }
'''
insert=needle+'''
    @Test
    fun `post write hold subtracts blocking tx time while retaining guard`() {
        assertEquals(1_250L, ChatRelayTurnPacing.postWriteHoldMs(32_000, 0L))
        assertEquals(850L, ChatRelayTurnPacing.postWriteHoldMs(32_000, 400L))
        assertEquals(250L, ChatRelayTurnPacing.postWriteHoldMs(32_000, 1_200L))
    }
'''
assert needle in s
p.write_text(s.replace(needle, insert, 1))
PY
set +e
gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayTurnPacingTest --no-daemon > /tmp/relay-pacing-v2-red.log 2>&1
RED_RC=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/relay-pacing-v2-red.log
test $RED_RC -ne 0
grep -F 'postWriteHoldMs' /tmp/relay-pacing-v2-red.log >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/developerrelay/ChatRelayTurnPacing.kt')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''    fun postTxHoldMs(
        pcmBytes: Int,
        sampleRateHz: Int = LocalSpeechFormat.SAMPLE_RATE_HZ,
    ): Long = pcmDurationMs(pcmBytes, sampleRateHz) + PLAYBACK_GUARD_MS
'''
replacement=needle+'''
    fun postWriteHoldMs(
        pcmBytes: Int,
        txWriteWallMs: Long,
        sampleRateHz: Int = LocalSpeechFormat.SAMPLE_RATE_HZ,
    ): Long {
        require(txWriteWallMs >= 0L) { "tx_write_wall_ms_must_not_be_negative" }
        return maxOf(
            PLAYBACK_GUARD_MS,
            postTxHoldMs(pcmBytes, sampleRateHz) - txWriteWallMs,
        )
    }
'''
assert needle in s
p.write_text(s.replace(needle, replacement, 1))

p=Path('app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/developerrelay/ChatRelayLiveCallProbe.kt')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''                val postTxHoldMs = ChatRelayTurnPacing.postTxHoldMs(pcm.size)
                lines += "turn_${turn}_tts_pcm_duration_ms=$ttsPcmDurationMs"
                lines += "turn_${turn}_post_tx_hold_ms=$postTxHoldMs"
''','''                val postTxHoldMs = ChatRelayTurnPacing.postTxHoldMs(pcm.size)
                lines += "turn_${turn}_tts_pcm_duration_ms=$ttsPcmDurationMs"
                lines += "turn_${turn}_post_tx_hold_ms=$postTxHoldMs"
''',1)
old='''                val txWriteStarted = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                lease.uplink().write(pcm)
                lease.uplink().flush()
                lines += "turn_${turn}_tx_write_wall_ms=${(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - txWriteStarted).coerceAtLeast(0L)}"
                totalTxBytes += pcm.size.toLong()
                lines += "turn_${turn}_tx_pcm_bytes=${pcm.size}"
                handler.postDelayed(
                    { completeTurnAfterPlayback(turn, generation, lease) },
                    postTxHoldMs,
                )
'''
new='''                val txWriteStarted = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                lease.uplink().write(pcm)
                lease.uplink().flush()
                val txWriteWallMs =
                    (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - txWriteStarted).coerceAtLeast(0L)
                val postWriteHoldMs = ChatRelayTurnPacing.postWriteHoldMs(
                    pcmBytes = pcm.size,
                    txWriteWallMs = txWriteWallMs,
                )
                lines += "turn_${turn}_tx_write_wall_ms=$txWriteWallMs"
                lines += "turn_${turn}_post_write_hold_ms=$postWriteHoldMs"
                totalTxBytes += pcm.size.toLong()
                lines += "turn_${turn}_tx_pcm_bytes=${pcm.size}"
                handler.postDelayed(
                    { completeTurnAfterPlayback(turn, generation, lease) },
                    postWriteHoldMs,
                )
'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

p=Path('scripts/chatgpt_relay_live_call.py')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''        "post_tx_hold_ms",
        "first_tx_elapsed_ms",
'''
replacement='''        "post_tx_hold_ms",
        "post_write_hold_ms",
        "first_tx_elapsed_ms",
'''
assert needle in s
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,replacement,1))

p=Path('scripts/test_chatgpt_relay_live_call.py')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''            "turn_1_output_pcm_ready_elapsed_ms": "4300",
            "turn_1_eos_to_first_tx_ms": "3500",
'''
replacement='''            "turn_1_output_pcm_ready_elapsed_ms": "4300",
            "turn_1_post_write_hold_ms": "850",
            "turn_1_eos_to_first_tx_ms": "3500",
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,replacement,1)
needle='''        self.assertIn("turn_1_eos_to_first_tx_ms=3500", joined)
'''
replacement='''        self.assertIn("turn_1_post_write_hold_ms=850", joined)
        self.assertIn("turn_1_eos_to_first_tx_ms=3500", joined)
'''
assert needle in s
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,replacement,1))
PY
git diff --check
gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayTurnPacingTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayDownlinkPumpTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayBackendTest --no-daemon
python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_chatgpt_relay_live_call.py'
gradle :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon
git diff --check
git add app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/developerrelay/ChatRelayTurnPacing.kt app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/developerrelay/ChatRelayLiveCallProbe.kt app/src/test/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/developerrelay/ChatRelayTurnPacingTest.kt scripts/chatgpt_relay_live_call.py scripts/test_chatgpt_relay_live_call.py
git commit -m 'fix: account for blocking relay tx writes'
git push origin HEAD:agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo chatgpt_relay_tx_pacing_v2_green=true
echo relay_tx_pacing_v2_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
